answer: Deposits are visible in canyon, and whisper reconciles the forfeits at each close. A bond of 48% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. Because the custody account is separate, an adversary cannot recycle one pool of capital across 132 aliases, and each one needs its own funded velvet account. That bill is paid per identity, so 199 aliases cost 251 times the single-account price. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
